mentions.name: HypeKrew
mentions.description: A set of tools for YouTube content creators to better connect with their viewers. The MVP focuses on building an independent line of communication with a creator's audience and delivering predictive, just-in-time notifications via push or email when a specific viewer is predicted to have time to watch videos on YouTube, so creators stay on top of viewers' notification stacks instead of disappearing among a flood of notifications.
mentions.problem: Repeated issues observed when consulting with creators and helping them grow their channels: creators struggle to stay connected with viewers, and their notifications disappear amongst a flood of other notifications.
mentions.source_excerpt:
We're building https://HypeKrew.com/?ref=hn. It is going to be a set of tools for YouTube content creators to better connect with their viewers, based on repeated issues that we've observed when consulting with creators and helping them grow their channels. Right now there's an MVP available, which focuses on

- building an independent line of communication with your audience

- predictive, just in time notifications through push or email delivered when we predict that specific viewer has the time to view videos on YouTube, ensuring you stay on top of their notification stack and don't disappear amongst a flood of notifications.
